title: BRIDGE: Bilevel Retrieval-Credit-Aware Agentic Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.36505v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning (ARL) with verifiable rewards improves the ability of large language models (LLMs) to tackle knowledge-intensive tasks by learning to interleave search and reasoning. However, most existing ARL methods optimize only LLM-generated tokens and treat retrieved evidence as environment observations. This creates an information-credit gap: failures caused by missing or misleading evidence are attributed to the LLM policy rather than to the retriever, which motivates training the LLM and the retriever jointly. In this paper, we show that retrieval and LLM policy learning are order-sensitive: adapting the retriever before optimizing the policy yields a larger reward gain than the reverse order. To preserve this hierarchy while allowing both components to co-adapt, we formulate retrieval-augmented agentic RL as a bilevel optimization problem. translated_title: BRIDGE：双层检索-信用感知的智能体强化学习
translated_abstract: 带可验证奖励的智能体强化学习（ARL）通过学习交错执行搜索与推理，提升了大语言模型（LLM）处理知识密集型任务的能力。然而，现有的大多数 ARL 方法只优化 LLM 生成的 token，并将检索到的证据视为环境观测。这造成了“信息-信用”鸿沟：由证据缺失或误导所导致的失败被归因于 LLM 策略，而非检索器，这促使人们考虑对 LLM 与检索器进行联合训练。在本文中，我们证明检索与 LLM 策略学习是顺序敏感的：先适配检索器再优化策略，比相反顺序能带来更大的奖励增益。为了在保持这一层级关系的同时让两个组件协同适应，我们将检索增强的智能体强化学习形式化为一个双层优化问题。为了高效求解该问题，我们提出了 BRIDGE，一种内存高效的一阶（方法）……（摘要此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出的 BRIDGE 将检索增强的智能体强化学习形式化为双层优化问题，以信用感知、先适配检索器后优化策略的顺序敏感方式联合训练检索器与 LLM 策略，从而弥合现有 ARL 方法中检索证据未被归因的信息-信用鸿沟。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes BRIDGE, which formulates retrieval-augmented agentic reinforcement learning as a bilevel optimization problem and jointly trains the retriever and LLM policy in a credit-aware, order-sensitive manner (adapting the retriever first), thereby closing the information-credit gap in existing ARL methods.
